::: {.column width="65%"}

I am a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University, with a focus on data communication, public health analytics, and data visualisation. This website is built for the ETC5523 Communicating with Data assessment, where I explore how data-driven insights can be translated into clear, accessible stories for non-technical audiences.

My academic background spans financial mathematics and business analytics, with particular interest in infectious disease modelling and public health policy evaluation. I believe effective data storytelling relies not just on technical rigour, but also on thoughtful design that respects the reader’s time and context.

Beyond coursework, I enjoy experimenting with web-based data visualisation and building reproducible analytical workflows.
